hardening.minimized_reason: No feature-minimization claim has been established for this package.
hardening.pledge_reason: No package-enforced pledge-style capability policy is claimed; service confinement is tracked in Werewolf forms.

changes.what: MediaWiki for werewolf's mediawiki form, as Wolfi would package it: the release tarball, checked by sha256, laid in /usr/share/mediawiki. It is PHP, so nothing is compiled; the form names the PHP it runs on. 1.43 is the long-term release, supported into December 2027: an update's schema changes are one way, and a slot rolled back must still read /data. The test suite and the web installer are left out: the form installs from the machine's config before the wiki serves. Offered to wolfi-dev/os as it is; when Wolfi ships it, the form names the package and this file goes.
changes.why: Provide an independently maintained application context with immutable sources and separately updatable Wolfi dependencies.

wolfi.removal_condition: Wolfi provides equivalent packaging, supported versions, architectures and required hardening; review compatibility before retiring this context.
